u-shared-four-comparator-three-level-qua.limitations: All declared histories have independent current-stencil friction/normal forces, original1e-9N constrained balances and complete corner/quadrature fields at every one of744 original loading stages. The same six physical initialization coordinates, pad5 geometry, source definitions,12/604/64/64 stages and physical parameters remain fixed. All75 original material probes remain, with no subset removal, and full global unaveraged lower/upper peaks and locations stay visible. Proper finite frames and direct nonlinear deformation gradients use the original comparison method. Body geometry/mass and volume/contact-trace discretization remain coupled; this removes the earlier initialization-coordinate/count confound without establishing a pure bulk axis, contact pressure, regularization/history tail, continuum feedback/model accuracy or verified warmed native cost. The original differently initialized cases are not replaced. Three useful levels alone do not prove convergence.

u-shared-initialization-fourth-anchor-tr.scope: Test original shared U initialization coordinates on a remeshed body without moving any anchor.
u-shared-initialization-fourth-anchor-tr.limitations: Original physical coordinates and components remain byte-exact. No new physical equilibrium, shared fourth-level history or convergence is accepted.
